dedupeText: retro compilation album cover layout 1950s style compilation purple and black serif typography inset images rockabilly aesthetic black header containing primary display text contrasted against a purple field diagonal arrangement of two square image insets with yellow borders centered tracklist text positioned between the two image insets bold volume numbering in the upper right quadrant of the purple field combine a dark header bar with a vibrant primary field using diagonal image placement and centered list based typography to create a retro anthology aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-panel graphic layout featuring a black header and a purple main body, containing two smaller inset album covers arranged diagonally, flanked by tracklist text and volume numbering.
coreVisualRelationships: Black header containing primary display text contrasted against a purple field.
Diagonal arrangement of two square image insets with yellow borders.
Centered tracklist text positioned between the two image insets.
Bold volume numbering in the upper right quadrant of the purple field.
coreInvariants: Use of heavy slab and transitional serifs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary artist name dominates the top black bar; secondary album art insets are scaled down to approximately 30% of the total width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white serif text in the black header acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down from the header, moving diagonally from the top-left inset to the bottom-right inset, passing through the central tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant purple negative space in the center and right side to balance the density of the insets.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black (header bar and side margin)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation purple paired with high-value white text for maximum legibility.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast in display text
Wide tracking for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Drop shadow applied to header text to create depth against black.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for titles paired with a clean, condensed sans-serif for information lists.
graphicDevices: Thin yellow borders around image insets

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic, high-contrast serif look of the main title.
Appropriate for the dense, readable tracklist text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a graphic layout with a solid black header bar and a large purple rectangular field below it. Place two square image placeholders with thin yellow borders: one in the upper-left of the purple field and one in the lower-right. Add a black vertical bar on the far left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large white serif text centered in the black header. Add a large yellow number in the upper right of the purple field. Center a list of white sans-serif text in the middle of the purple field between the two image placeholders.

verificationChecks: Is the header text white with a subtle shadow?
Are the image insets arranged diagonally?
Is the background color a consistent deep purple?
Is the tracklist text centered and all-caps?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the borders.
Verify the yellow accent color is consistent across borders and volume text.
Check that the black header is perfectly horizontal.
Confirm the tracklist is vertically centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark header bar with a vibrant primary field, using diagonal image placement and centered list-based typography to create a retro anthology aesthetic.
